parameters.name: category
parameters.description:
The category of the inspection item. Valid values:
- security: security and compliance
- performance: performance and efficiency 
- stability: business stability
- limitation: service limits 
- cost: cost optimization.

parameters.name: enableFilter
parameters.description: Specifies whether to filter check items. If set to true, only abnormal check items with result=true are returned.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description:
The query language. Valid values:
- zh_CN
- en_US.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description:
The level of the inspection item. Valid values:
- advice: suggestion
- warning: low-risk
- error: medium-risk
- critical: high-risk.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50.

parameters.name: targetType
parameters.description: The object type of the inspection target. Only check items that match the specified targetType are returned.
